page_title: How to ensure security at the speed of DevOps

sources.entry: 6. 6 Ways to bring security to the speed of DevOps (Gitlab)

summary.title: How to ensure security at the speed of DevOps
summary.one_liner: Learn why security should move to the start of the SDLC, with automated tests, developer education, and shared security-DevOps priorities, so teams can ship fast without skipping security.
keywords: security at the speed of devops
takeaways: Move security testing to the start of the SDLC and embed it throughout, rather than testing only before launch.
Run automated tests on small code units at commit time so developers can fix vulnerabilities immediately.
Prioritize risks by likelihood of exploitation as well as severity, using guidelines agreed by DevOps and security teams.
Educate developers to recognize and fix common vulnerabilities, and educate security staff on application development.
Use integrated or single lifecycle tooling and open communication to keep security and DevOps teams aligned.
summary.summary: This 2019 GitLab blog post argues that security does not have to slow DevOps delivery. It recommends moving security practices, tests, and policies earlier in the software development lifecycle and automating them in the pipeline, so developers can remediate issues as code is committed. The article also covers developer education, prioritizing risks by likelihood of exploitation (citing IBM's Joe Coletta), and cross-team communication, noting that a single integrated tool can add transparency. It is an opinion and practices piece with no step-by-step technical instructions.
